title: Maize Single Tetrad-stage Microspore Sequencing
protocol: Isolate plants presenting tetrad-stage pollen in the field.
Harvest the top ~30 cm part containing tassels into a flask filled with water.
Release cells from three same-stage anthers into Isolation Buffer on a slide.
Identify samples containing the last-stage tetrads, from which microspores can be easily separated and do not adhere to glass tools.
Isolate a single tetrad into a new drop of Isolation Buffer using a thin glass pipette.
Use a thin glass pipette system and Programmable Microinjector PM 2000 to isolate single tetrads under 4×microscopy.
Repeated aspiration in and out was used to destroy the cell walls and disrupt the tetrads.
Separate four microspores without cell wall.
Place cells in less than 0.5μl Isolation Buffer into PCR wells filled with 4μl PBS.
Add 3μl lysis buffer (DLB : DTT = 11 : 1) into the PCR well containing a cell sample.
Centrifuge briefly, then incubate at 65℃ for 10 min.
Add 3μl stop buffer to the PCR well.
Centrifuge briefly and keep the PCR well on ice.
Prepare the following mixture: Mix 29 μl Reaction Buffer, 9 μl sc d2H2O, and 2 μl reaction enzyme per one reaction.
Add the mixture to PCR well containing 10 μl sample.
Centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at 30°C for 8 h.
Incubate at 65°C for 3 min.
Store it at -20°C if not proceeding to the next step immediately.
Dilute the amplification product 1:50.
Use the 10 markers (Table 1) to amplify the diluted DNA by PCR.
Mix 1 μl diluted DNA, 1 μl forward primer (5 mM), 1 μl reverse primer (5 mM), 1.5 μl 10×PCR Buffer (Takara), 0.3 μl dNTP (10 mM), 0.15 μl rTaq (Katara), and 10.05 μl d2H2O for the PCR mixture.
Perform PCR with the following cycling parameters: Process Temperature Duration Cycles see Table 2.
Detect the PCR product by 2% Agarose gel electrophoresis.
Sample with no less than 8 of the 10 markers successfully amplified is considered to be of a quality sufficient to make a library.
Add 4 μl amplification product into 100 μl dH2O.
Measure the DNA concentration by Nanodrop 2000.
Dilute DNA to 1.2 μg in 60 μl.
Fragment the DNA by sonication at ~5°C for a few cycles (30s sonication and 30s rest per cycle).
Continue sonicating until most of the DNA fragments range from 300bp to 500bp.
Detect fragment size using 2% Agarose gel electrophoresis.
Add 40 μl End Repair Mix and 10 μl Resuspension Buffer to 50 μl of DNA fragmented.
Mix thoroughly.
Incubate the mixture at 30°C for 30 min.
Keep Agencourt Ampure XP beads at room temperature (RT) and vortex briefly.
Add 160 μl Beads to 100 μl of end-repaired sample.
Mix thoroughly.
Incubate the sample at RT for 15 min.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand at RT for 15 min.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant using a 200 μl pipette.
Add 200 μl fresh 80% EtOH to the Beads, incubate at RT for 30 s.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Add another 200 μl fresh 80% EtOH to complete washing, incubate at RT for 30 s.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Let the sample dry at RT for ~5-10 min.
Remove the Beads from the magnetic stand.
Add 17.5 μl Resuspension Buffer to the Beads.
Mix thoroughly.
Incubate at RT for 2 min.
Place the mixture on a magnetic stand at RT for 5 min.
Transfer 15 μl of supernatant into a new PCR well.
Add 2.5 μl Resuspension Buffer and 12.5 μl A Tailing Mix to the PCR well containing 15 μl sample.
Mix thoroughly.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Ligate adapters: Add 2.5 μl Resuspension Buffer to the PCR well.
Add 2.5 μl Index to the PCR well containing Resuspension Buffer.
Add 2.5 μl Ligation Mix to the PCR well.
Mix thoroughly, and incubate at 30°C for 10 minutes.
Add 5 μl Stop Buffer immediately after ligation.
Mix thoroughly with Stop Buffer.
Place Agencourt Ampure XP beads at room temperature and vortex.
Add 42.5 μl of beads to 42.5 μl of the Ligation sample.
Mix thoroughly, then incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Remove and discard the supernatant using a 200 μl pipette.
Add 200 μl fresh 80% EtOH to the sample.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl fresh 80% EtOH again to complete washing.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then remove and discard the supernatant.
Let the sample dry at room temperature for approximately 5-10 minutes.
Keep this sample containing beads away from the magnetic stand.
Add 22.5 μl Resuspension Buffer to the dried sample.
Mix thoroughly and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place the sample on a magnetic stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Transfer 20 μl of the supernatant into a new PCR well.
After 2% Agarose gel electrophoresis, excise the gel segment containing the main target band.
The size range of the main target band should be limited to 100 bp.
Add 900 μl QG Buffer to a 2 ml tube containing 300 mg gel.
Incubate at room temperature until the gel melts completely.
Add 300 μl isopropanol to the melted gel solution.
Mix thoroughly.
Place a MinElute column in a new 2ml collection tube.
Transfer 750μl of the melted sample into the MinElute column and centrifuge at 13000 rpm for 1min. Discard the flow-through.
Repeat step by transferring another 750μl and centrifuging.
Add 500μl QG Buffer to the column, centrifuge for 1min and discard the flow-through.
Add 750μl PE Buffer to the column, let stand for 5min, then centrifuge for 1min. Discard the flow-through.
Centrifuge the column for an additional 1min at 13000 rpm to remove residual ethanol completely.
Place the column into a clean 1.5ml tube and let it dry at room temperature for 5min.
Add 23μl EB Buffer onto the center of the column membrane, incubate at room temperature for 3min, then centrifuge for 1 min.
Let the flow-through be collected and add it back onto the center of the same column membrane, incubate at room temperature for 3min, then centrifuge for 1 min.
The flow-through from this step is the purified sample for PCR reaction.
Add 5 μl Primer to 20 μl of Purified sample.
Add 25 μl PCR Mix to the mixture containing Primer and Purified sample.
Mix thoroughly.
Perform PCR with specified cycling parameters.
Keep Agencourt Ampure XP beads at room temperature and vortex.
Add 50 μl Beads to 50 μl of the PCR sample.
Mix thoroughly.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Place the mixture on a magnetic stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Remove and discard the supernatant using a 200 μl pipette.
Add 200 μl fresh 80% EtOH, incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Add another 200 μl fresh 80% EtOH to complete washing, incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Let the sample dry at room temperature for 5-10 minutes.
Place the dried Beads away from the magnetic stand.
Add 22.5 μl Resuspension Buffer to the Beads.
Mix thoroughly.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place the mixture on a magnetic stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Transfer 20 μl of the supernatant into a new PCR well as the library.
Store the library at -20°C up to two months.
